lessons.lesson: A measurement is not a premise. The audit called the front page 'pre-contract'; the verification found the contract, layout and ground rules already there, and only the status section stale. Read the artefact before ruling on it, or the ruling is fiction.
lessons.applied_to: the ruling was narrowed from a rewrite to a refresh plus an appendix

lessons.lesson: Batch status is not evidence of completeness. A killed driver can leave a board half-driven; the board must be read back before any card is reported done.
lessons.applied_to: the board was re-read through the CLI and the histogram recorded

lessons.lesson: Every subprocess call needs a bound. One unbounded CLI call turns a round into a hang with no output, which is the worst state to hand over.
lessons.applied_to: each call in the second driver carries its own timeout and its own recorded exit

lessons.lesson: A native tool must never be handed a python Path string. Backslashes are not a bash path; a silent no-op looks like a pass.
lessons.applied_to: the validator was re-run with a forward-slash path and its output captured

lessons.lesson: The readback is what catches the pack's own gaps: two of this round's three self-found defects were found only by comparing published bytes back.
lessons.applied_to: the homepage was uploaded to the root and re-read; the receipt now records 10 of 10

lessons.lesson: A check must be able to fail. Twelve injected mutations are what separate a check from a claim that a check exists.
lessons.applied_to: SELF_CHECK_RECEIPT.json carries the mutation table and any undetected mutation by name

lessons.lesson: A reader's verdict must be recorded where it can be read, not where the sandbox allows. When a checker cannot write, transcribe its output with the stream hash.
lessons.applied_to: VERDICT.md carries the lane's stdout hash as provenance

lessons.lesson: Deleting a ref is only reversible if the tip is recorded first. Hygiene without a rollback ref is destruction.
lessons.applied_to: every removal recorded its tip commit and the exact restore command

artifact_disclosure.context_truncation: large single-file writes were truncated by the context layer; the round's scripts were split into small files after the first attempt failed to land
artifact_disclosure.hung_driver: the first four-surface driver hung with a zero-byte log and was killed
artifact_disclosure.same_model_lanes: the writer and the checker ran the same mandated model; model-axis independence ABSENT
